gold: Acute myocardial infarction due to critical stenosis of the proximal left anterior descending artery, presenting with de Winter ECG pattern evolving to Wellens syndrome

selector.rationale: Elevated serum troponin I level and ECG findings of ST-segment elevation and depression, along with coronary angiography showing 95% stenosis of the proximal left anterior descending artery, support myocardial infarction as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Hypertensive Heart Disease
rejected.why: Lack of significant findings supporting hypertensive heart disease as the primary diagnosis

rejected.label: Coronary Artery Disease
rejected.why: While coronary artery disease is present, the acute presentation and laboratory findings point more specifically to myocardial infarction
